summary: Iteration 28 tested: v0.6.5-Beta version endpoint, maintenance mode CMS controls + public splash + newsletter capture, PortalRegistrationCreate accepting submissions without address/postal, plain-text country/region/city location display block on Portal & admin User editor, and AvatarPicker without 'Overige' tab. All backend pytest cases pass (4/4). Frontend flows for footer/sidebar version, Engineering tab, maintenance ON->public splash->newsletter->done state, maintenance OFF, and portal register without address all succeeded.

issues: Persistent blue banner 'Nieuwe versie v0.5.5-Beta is uitgerold' is hard-coded and stale — sidebar/footer show v0.6.5-Beta but this banner still says v0.5.5-Beta. Update the changelog announcement text (or drive it from APP_VERSION) so it doesn't contradict the dynamic version.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Update the CMS/admin 'Nieuwe versie vX.Y.Z-Beta is uitgerold' announcement banner to reference the current APP_VERSION (currently hard-coded to 0.5.5-Beta while the app is on 0.6.5-Beta).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx is >2700 lines — consider splitting SettingsAdmin, UserEditor and other panels into separate files for maintainability.
MaintenanceGate polls /api/site/maintenance every 60s per open tab — this is fine but consider gating on visibilitychange to avoid background polling.

LocalCaptcha wraps a sr-only checkbox; Playwright can't click it without force=True or clicking the label — consider making the visible span the actual clickable target with proper role='checkbox' for a11y.
seed_data_creation: None — test data prefixed TEST_ (newsletter subscribers + one portal registration).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/site/version and /api/site/maintenance are stable. Settings PUT accepts all maintenance_* fields. Portal /api/portal/register accepts submissions without address/postal_code. AvatarPicker exposes tabs: all/masculine/feminine/robots (no overige). Location displays use data-testid='portal-reg-location-display' and 'user-details-location-display'. Maintenance was toggled off at end — public site is live.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the scoped features; only a minor stale hard-coded changelog banner noted.
